## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad weekly leadership across Staples/Materials/Tech winners and concurrent large-cap divergences (mega-cap semis down). Leadership: Broad (Top 5 spread across 4 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples lead: EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +12.50% | 1M: +25.16%) ABOVE TREND. Materials/Healthcare strong: FCX (1W: +13.78% | 1M: +24.28%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities, Industrials and Technology are the weakest this week: Utilities (1W: -2.82%), Industrials: CAT (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -8.74%) BELOW TREND, Technology shows mixed weakness: ASML (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +13.78% | 1M: +24.28%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +12.50% | 1M: +25.16%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +24.83%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -9.79% | 1M: +1.63%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -9.45% | 1M: -9.61%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -9.73% | 1M: -12.49%) BELOW TREND, TXN (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in semiconductors.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W momentum: EL (1W: +23.46%), FCX (1W: +13.78%), TGT (1W: +12.50%). Major divergence across mega-caps (AAPL RECOVERY, NVDA CORRECTION, INTC BELOW TREND) — watch for trend breaks; treat moves as tactical, not yet broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak in the week with internal winners: INTU (1W: +10.23% | 1M: +24.83%) ABOVE TREND, ACN (1W: +9.74% | 1M: +26.90%) ABOVE TREND, but large-cap semis are lagging: ASML (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION. Technology showing internal rotation (24 stocks; 1W: -1.56% | 1M: +9.33%).

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed/flat this week: V (1W: +6.57% | 1M: +7.70%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +6.69% | 1M: +11.16%) ABOVE TREND, but JPM (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +0.90%) CORRECTION and sector 1W: -0.12% — Financials are mixed, not uniformly leading.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive strength this week: MRK (1W: +10.80% | 1M: +14.95%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +4.41%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +3.66%) ABOVE TREND — Healthcare showing sector strength (1W: +3.97% | 1M: +7.14%).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to Consumer Staples, Materials and selected Healthcare/Software winners (EL, FCX, MRK, INTU) and reduce exposure to lagging semiconductors and Utilities. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; exercise caution given mega-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: EL (1W: +23.46% | 1M: +29.69%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +8.79% | 1M: +29.63%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +13.78% | 1M: +24.28%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION, CAT (1W: -8.01% | 1M: -8.74%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Staples (1W: +5.67%), Healthcare (1W: +3.97%), Materials (1W: +1.54%). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.56%), Industrials (1W: -2.39%), Utilities (1W: -2.82%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -7.35% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION — watch weekly support and whether semis stabilize. AAPL (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -6.73%) RECOVERY — watch follow-through to confirm reversal. INTC (1W: -15.68% | 1M: -5.48%) BELOW TREND — watch for capitulation vs. stabilization candles.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NOW (+50): NOW (1W: +8.79% | 1M: +29.63%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. BA (+65): BA (1W: -6.86% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION — sentiment (F-15 win) diverging from weekly weakness, watch for follow-through. PM (+80): news positive (FDA author.), monitor price action for confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ASML (-40): ASML (1W: -7.59% | 1M: -0.84%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price are aligned. UBER (-75): regulator fine headline is bearish; monitor price action for confirmation. TTWO (-50): headline-linked losses; watch for further downside if weekly weakness continues.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. EL, FCX and INTU showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND) while NVDA and INTC are the largest weekly drags (CORRECTION / BELOW TREND). Key risk: major-cap divergence and mixed news signals (e.g., NOW/BA confirming and ASML/UBER showing negative headlines) — watch for trend confirmation.
